instruction.german: Read the conversation in Figure it out. Then choose the correct option to complete the rules in the grammar box.

parts:
Figure it out

A: I want to make a cake. How much sugar have we got?

B: We haven’t got much – about 200 grams.

A: OK, what about eggs? How many eggs have we got?

B: I think we’ve got eight eggs.


Grammar | much / many

We usually use much and many with questions and negatives.

We use much with 1 nouns and many with 2 nouns.

How much bread have we got?

We haven’t got much time before classes start.

How many oranges have we got?

There aren’t many tomatoes in this salad.
